summary: The diff implements most of the required features across frontend and backend. Key areas are well-covered: Caffeine removal, Footer replacement, global yellow styles, HomePage rebuild, Profile page, backend profile fields, DAO pages, Chat page, Map page, and App.tsx routes. However, several specific acceptance criteria are only partially met or have gaps, and the welcome message text diverges from the spec. REQ-11 (canister ID enforcement) lacks direct evidence in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Welcome message must read exactly 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World'
missing_requirements.reason: HomePage.tsx shows the welcome message as 'Bem-vindo ao mundo Quantumoney' (Portuguese), not the English 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World' specified in the requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: photoUrl field must be Text (base64) in PlayerProfile stable record
missing_requirements.reason: migration.mo and backend/main.mo use photoUrl as ?Storage.ExternalBlob rather than a Text/base64 field as specified in the requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Verify and enforce that all frontend canister references in useARGameData.ts, useICPLedger.ts, useQMYLedger.ts, TechnicalValidationPanel.tsx, and CanisterArchitecturePanel.tsx use the Carteira A canister IDs
missing_requirements.reason: None of the files useARGameData.ts, useICPLedger.ts, useQMYLedger.ts, TechnicalValidationPanel.tsx, or CanisterArchitecturePanel.tsx appear in the diff as modified or added. There is no evidence that canister IDs were verified or enforced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Transaction history section displays past token movements for both ICP and QMY
missing_requirements.reason: Perfil.tsx references useQMYTransactions for QMY history but there is no evidence of ICP transaction history being fetched or displayed — only the QMY transactions hook is used.

hallucinated_features.description: Legacy route aliases /profile redirecting to /perfil, /central-bank redirecting to /banco-central, and /dao/new redirecting to /dao/create
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention any legacy route aliases or redirects. These were added in App.tsx without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Extra pages beyond the required list registered in App.tsx: TermsOfServicePage, PrivacyPolicyPage, GameSystemsPage, ARDistributionPage, TreasuryMonetaryPolicyPage
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-12 lists specific pages to register. These additional pages are not mentioned in the requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Stripe payment integration imported and included in backend/main.mo
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request makes no mention of Stripe payment integration. The backend imports Stripe and StripeMixin modules which were not requested.
